description:
An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) in Baltimore County, MD. We are partnering with a premier skilled nursing facility seeking a dynamic leader to oversee operations and ensure the highest standards of patient care and regulatory compliance. This confidential role offers a chance to make a significant impact within a supportive and forward-thinking environment.
The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall management of the facility, including clinical services, financial performance, and staff development. This position is ideal for an experienced LNHA looking to advance their career with a competitive salary package. Join a team committed to excellence and providing compassionate care to its residents.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Proven experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Strong leadership, operational, and financial management abilities.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, based on experience and qualifications.
